subject: Co-host proposal: EmberCon micro-summit + partner dev-hack
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: maya@edgeshift.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Co-host proposal: EmberCon micro-summit + partner dev-hack

Hi Maya —

Quick note to see if EdgeShift would be interested in co-hosting a micro-summit at EmberCon (San Francisco, March). We’re proposing a light, developer-first package that combines:

- 60-minute partner panel (product + tech)
- 90-minute hands-on mini-hack: 3 guided exercises for engineers (Redwood + EdgeShift templates)
- Co-published blog post and 2-week promo swap (email + socials)
- 5 comp passes + 2 speaker registrations per partner

High-level asks from EdgeShift: one senior engineer as co-instructor for the hack, a short speaker bio, and 2 social posts during the promo window. In exchange we’ll provide co-branded landing page, registration list share (MQLs), and run the demo infra for the hack. I attached a short outline with timing and promotional windows.

If you’re interested, next steps I’d propose:
1) Confirm staffing and whether you need booth/sponsor upgrades (we can coordinate budget)
2) Share speaker bios by next Wed (2026-11-18)
3) Approve a draft co-marketing timeline and CTA

Would EdgeShift like to fast-track a 20-minute call this week to lock scope? I can make time Tue afternoon or Thu morning PST.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Partner Marketing
Redwood Inference
attachments: embercon_micro-summit-outline.pdf

From: maya@edgeshift.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: amit@edgeshift.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-host proposal: EmberCon micro-summit + partner dev-hack

Hi Lauren —

Really like this format. EdgeShift is interested, particularly in the hands-on hack piece — great way for product-led engineers to try the integration. A few quick items from our side:

- Confirmed: Shalini Iyer (Sr. ML Engineer) can co-instruct the hack
- Speaker bios attached (edgeshift_speaker_bios.docx)
- We have a small booth budget but will likely need 2 additional sponsor passes beyond the 5 comp passes you mentioned

Two questions:
1) Can Redwood provide a short pre-built repo with starter datasets so attendees can get moving in the first 15 minutes?
2) How will lead capture work for GDPR attendees? We have EU customers that may attend and need clear consent flows.

We can do a 20-minute sync Thu 11/13 10:00am PST or Fri 11/14 9:00am PST — Claire (our Events lead) will join on the call.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Partnerships, EdgeShift
attachments: edgeshift_speaker_bios.docx

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: maya@edgeshift.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-13T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-host proposal: EmberCon micro-summit + partner dev-hack

Thanks Maya — great to hear. Looping in Jonas (field/events) and Marissa (alliances) to confirm logistics and tracking. Quick answers and notes below:

- Starter repo: Yes — we’ll provide a GitHub repo with three guided exercises and a one-click deploy to our demo infra; I’ll ask Eng to cut it by end of month.
- GDPR / lead capture: we’ll use the co-branded landing page with a consent checkbox and segment EU leads separately in the MQL export. Legal will add the standard DPA language; Marissa, can you confirm the export fields we can share?
- Sponsor passes: noted — we can probably cover 2 additional passes but need to confirm budget and whether EdgeShift wants a half-booth upgrade (vendor to vendor).

Attached a draft promo schedule (draft_promo_schedule.xlsx) with proposed dates for blog swaps, emails, and social windows. Proposed timeline highlights:
- Speaker bios due: 2026-11-18
- Landing page live: 2026-12-08
- Promo window: 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-21
- Dry run (hack): 2027-02-25

Jonas / Marissa — can you: 1) confirm whether we can fund 2 extra passes and 2) list the fields we can export for MQLs (first, last, company, role, country, consent flag, lead source)?

Best,
Lauren
Partner Marketing, Redwood Inference
attachments: draft_promo_schedule.xlsx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, maya@edgeshift.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Co-host proposal: EmberCon micro-summit + partner dev-hack

Lauren — thanks for the outline. EdgeShift — excited to run this with you. Quick confirmations from my side:

- Budget: We can cover the 2 additional sponsor passes but not the half-booth upgrade; if EdgeShift wants the booth upgrade we should discuss cost share.
- MQL export: We can share the fields Lauren listed (first, last, company, role, country, consent flag, lead source). EU leads will be flagged and excluded from marketing exports until consent is confirmed.
- Legal / paperwork: Please sign the co-host agreement in DocuSign (linked) — we’ll need it back by 2026-11-30 to hit marketing deadlines.

Action items:
- EdgeShift: Send final speaker bios by 2026-11-18 (Maya)
- Lauren/Marissa: Publish co-branded landing page draft by 2026-12-08
- All: Schedule a 30-min content sync + dry-run slot in Feb (suggest 2027-02-25)

Looking forward — I’ll add this to the partner events calendar and create a HubSpot record (HUBSPOT-45721) for tracking.

Jonas Weber
Field Events, Redwood Inference
